description: I am a student, who is willing to form a team for the “Forgotten but not Abandoned“ challenge. Looking for fellow students who can join, who are skilled at writing, know about space exploration and pollution.
summary: our project tells the story of 4 different spacecrafts that have been abandoned in outer space . our project allows young enthusiasts to explore the moon and mars through their spacecrafts by mentioning how they served the world in discovering the planets they landed on . it addresses the abandoned but not forgotten challenge by telling the stories of abandoned  spacecrafts . we have developed a interactive spacecraft database for further exploration that includes a quiz to test knowledge .
details: our project provides a interesting insight of different abandoned spacecrafts to better know them and to explore their planets through them .
